description:
Purpose: Change a saved monitor without losing what it collected or what the user decided; send only what changes, since everything else stays as saved.
When: The user wants a different title, location, company, keyword or field on a saved monitor.
Cost: About 160 tokens for the saved monitor.

companies.description: Company names; a posting from any of them is kept, and leaving them out watches the whole market.

datePosted.description: How recently the posting was published; leave it out for any date.

department.description: One department slug, to narrow a title that spans departments; call job_postings_search_fields for what each one holds.

excludeKeywords.description: Words that must not appear in the title or the text, 1 to 10 words.

experience.description: Experience level to keep, given as exact, since a monitor keeps one level and no lowest level.

min.description: Keep this experience level and every level above it.

includeFamily.description: Also return postings from the resolved role's wider family; leave it out to keep the monitor's current setting.

includeNoSalary.description: Keep postings that publish no salary; true by default.

keywords.description: Words that must appear in the posting's text.

locations.description: Real location names, each read as the closest known location; check monitor.locations in the result for what it watches.

salaryCurrency.description: A three-letter currency code that only labels the monitor.

salaryMax.description: Highest yearly salary to keep, in US dollars after the same conversion.

salaryMin.description: Lowest yearly salary to keep, in US dollars after each posting's published salary is converted.

titleText.description: Words of the job title, matched to one of searchnapply's known roles (resolvedRole.display names it), which the monitor then watches.

name: monitor_update

companies.description: Companies the monitor keeps; empty for the whole market.

applied.description: The triage state over ALL of those postings (found and family alike), so New + Applied + Skipped == FoundTotal + FamilyTotal.

familyTotal.description: The postings matched in the family lane, under the same cap. FoundTotal and FamilyTotal partition every posting the monitor holds.

foundTotal.description: The postings matched in the exact and title lanes, under the monitor's per-user cap.

new.description: The triage state over ALL of those postings (found and family alike), so New + Applied + Skipped == FoundTotal + FamilyTotal.

skipped.description: The triage state over ALL of those postings (found and family alike), so New + Applied + Skipped == FoundTotal + FamilyTotal.

createdAt.description: When the monitor was saved, in UTC.

datePosted.description: How recently a kept posting was published.

department.description: The department the monitor narrows to.

slug.description: The department slug the department field takes.

employmentType.description: The employment type the monitor keeps.

excludeKeywords.description: Words that drop a posting whose title or text carries one.

experienceLevel.description: The experience level the monitor keeps.

id.description: The monitor id the other monitor tools take.

includeFamily.description: True when the role's wider family is watched too.

includeNoSalary.description: True when postings without a salary are kept.

keywords.description: Words a kept posting's text carries.

locations.description: The locations the monitor watches, as resolved.

salaryCurrency.description: The currency code that labels the monitor.

titleText.description: The title the monitor watches: the resolved role's name, or the words given.

resolvedRole.description: The role the title words were read as; absent when no role matched.

ambiguous.description: True when the title names several departments.

candidates.description: The departments an ambiguous title could mean; present only when ambiguous.

items.description: One department an ambiguous title could mean.

department.description: The department slug of the role, for the department field.
The department the role belongs to.

slug.description: The department slug the department field takes.

display.description: The role's name, which the search ran on.

titleNote.description: Present when no role matched: the title words are matched against posting titles.

unrecognizedLocations.description: The location names that matched no known location and were left out.

title: Update a job monitor
